column1: # ABI layout manifest for the vinary-tree interop resource ABI (wave W1, FV obligation #7).
# Single source of truth read by both docs/verification/smt/abi_layout.smt2
# (live-compiler and SMT-mirror agreement). The compiler side is pinned
# byte-agree with those pins, which derive from vinary-tree-interop/src/lib.rs.
#   64    - required LP64 tier (x86_64/aarch64): pointers, usize, and fn pointers
#   32arm - 32-bit ARM EABI (AAPCS) tier, CI leg linux-armv7-experimental:
#           pointers, usize, and fn pointers are 4 bytes; u64/f64 align to 8.
#   kind=struct, member=<field>  - offset/size columns are the field's byte
#                                  offset and width on each target.
#   kind=struct, member=__size   - size columns carry the struct's total size;
#   kind=struct, member=__align  - size columns carry the struct's alignment;
#   kind=enum                    - value is the u32 discriminant (repr(u32)).
#   kind=flag                    - value is the u64 bit value (power of two).
#   kind=const                   - value is the published constant; for the two
#                                  interface identifiers it is the exact 16-byte
#   '-'                          - column not applicable to this row kind.
